dict.string: FactTrail uses the microphone only when you choose to dictate incident notes.
FactTrail uses speech recognition to transcribe dictated notes into your documentation.
FactTrail uses your location only while creating an exchange record so the exchange location can be saved with your documentation.
FactTrail uses the camera so you can capture a photo or screenshot to attach to a timeline entry.
FactTrail uses your photo library so you can attach existing screenshots or photos to your timeline entries.
